parameters.name: BannedAll
parameters.description: Specifies whether to mute all users in the group.

parameters.name: BannnedUsers
parameters.description: The list of users to mute. You can specify up to 30 users. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,).

parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description: The data center. This must be the same data center specified in the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) call. Valid values: \`cn-shanghai\` (Shanghai) and \`ap-southeast-1\` (Singapore).

parameters.name: ExceptUsers
parameters.description: The list of users who are not muted when all users in the group are muted. You can specify up to 30 users. Separate multiple user IDs with a comma (,).
